item: Climate tab: six public datasets behind consent (R661, R662)
refs: PR #1935; R661; R662; RELEASE_0.6_GATE Row A
summary: One Climate main tab, a subtab per dataset (GISTEMP, NSIDC, ONI, USGS M6.0+ from 1973, OWID, a typed GHCN station); each names source, licence, last fetch, gaps, visible caveat; fetch only through the consent popup (consent:true 400, kill switch 409, bad station 422 before send); re-fetch stores only new or revised values as new vintages, identical re-fetch adds zero rows, withdrawn periods counted and kept; reads offline. Invariant 33.
